definitions.explanation: An old object valued for its age, rarity, craftsmanship, or historical significance. Includes furniture, ceramics, art, and other collectibles.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}の{家|いえ}には{骨董品|こっとうひん}がたくさんある。
examples.english: There are many antiques at my grandmother's house.

examples.japanese: この{骨董品|こっとうひん}は{江戸時代|えどじだい}のものだ。
examples.english: This antique is from the Edo period.

examples.japanese: {骨董品|こっとうひん}{店|てん}で{掛|か}け{軸|じく}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a hanging scroll at an antique shop.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{骨董|こっとう} originally referred to miscellaneous old items, and {品|ひん} means "goods" or "items."

COLLOCATIONS:
・{骨董品|こっとうひん}{店|てん}/{屋|や} - antique shop
・{骨董品|こっとうひん}を{集|あつ}める - to collect antiques
・{骨董品|こっとうひん}{市|いち} - antique market/fair
・{骨董品|こっとうひん}の{鑑定|かんてい} - antique appraisal

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・アンティーク - antique (loanword, often for Western items)
・{古美術|こびじゅつ} - antique art
・{古物|こぶつ} - secondhand goods
・{年代物|ねんだいもの} - old item, vintage
